chunks: O my son, whatever it may be, even though equal to a mustard seed in weight, or within a rock or in the sky or in the earth, God will bring it forth. Verily God is perceptive, all-aware.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God bringing forth even the smallest deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as the foundation for the concept of 'Amal' (deeds) being weighed with precision, reflecting God's 'Latif' (subtle) and 'Khabir' (all-aware) attributes. It underscores the inevitability of divine accounting, where even the smallest action, if hidden in the deepest recesses of creation, will be brought forth on the Day of Judgment. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on both outward observance and inward sincerity, as God's knowledge penetrates all layers of existence.
